crossRefs.note: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.
I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.
My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”
How much more, those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!
When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.”
Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness.

translations.web: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.
translations.bsb: So man wastes away like something rotten, like a moth-eaten garment.
translations.kjv: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.
translations.asv: Though I am like a rotten thing that consumeth, Like a garment that is moth-eaten.
